import sys
from threading import local

def main():
    solver = Main()
    solver.run_task()

class Main:
    def __init__(self):
        self.line = local()
        self.result = [0]  # Using list to allow modification in nested function
        
    def run_task(self):
        try:
            s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
            i = 0
            while i < len(s):
                j = i
                ch = s[i]
                while j < len(s) and s[j] == ch:
                    j += 1
                self.result[0] += (j - i + 1) % 2
                i = j
            print(self.result[0])
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(e)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
